card.name: Call after accidental overdose warning
card.fires_on: The word "call" right after "In case of accidental overdose," in child-safety warnings on product labels, just before "a doctor or poison control center".

modes.label: Overdose call instruction
modes.description: The verb "call" opens the instruction to contact a doctor or poison control after the keep-out-of-reach warning.
modes.example: In case of accidental overdose,<< call>> a doctor or poison control center immediately.

card.plain: It marks the word "call" in the standard label line telling readers who to contact after an accidental overdose.
